titles.title: Indian Beads

description: A cluster of black beads sits in the center of a circle of sharp, curved, talon-like forms. The talons extend outward from the center of the circle. The elements, all in shades of black and gray, contrast with the exposed white paper surrounding them.
title: Indian Beads
